resume: When it can be required (after-school care, outings), what it covers, how to check your child is not already insured, and how to arrange it between separated parents.
aQuoiCaSert: School insurance (assurance scolaire) protects your child during school activities and on the way to and from school. It combines two types of cover: civil liability (responsabilité civile), for damage the child causes to others, and personal accident insurance (individuelle accident corporel), for injuries the child suffers, even if they hurt themselves on their own. An "extra-curricular" (extra-scolaire) option also covers leisure activities and holidays.
quiEstConcerne: Parents of children in school, from nursery school to high school.
Parents whose child attends the town's after-school care or a school meal service, where a certificate may be required.
aSavoir: In principle, school insurance is optional for compulsory activities on the timetable.
It may be required for optional activities (outings, trips), the canteen and after-school activities organized by the town (commune).
Civil liability is often already included in your home insurance: check before you take out a policy.
If your child changes school, let your insurer know.
Indicative cost according to service-public.gouv.fr: from about €10 per year per child.
